name: Dixon Power Systems
old_description: After 17 years of owning an automotive repair shop, Jon Dixon needed a new challenge and had a growing interest in Renewable Energy. With the encouragement of his wife Holly, the business was launched. Dixon Power Systems began as a part-time business in the spring of 1999 and expanded to full time in January of 2005.
about:
Dixon Power Systems operates from Lincoln, Nebraska, where Jon and Holly Dixon launched the business in the spring of 1999 after Jon spent 17 years running an automotive repair shop. The venture began part‑time and moved to full‑time operation in January 2005, driven by Jon’s growing interest in renewable energy and Holly’s encouragement.

The company designs and installs solar photovoltaic and wind generation systems for customers seeking energy independence. A storefront allows visitors to learn about and purchase equipment for producing their own electricity. Jon applies his automotive mechanical and electrical background to tailor each system for site‑specific constraints, maximizing efficiency while addressing environmental concerns and ease of operation.

Clients include homeowners and remote‑site operators who are too far from utility lines, want backup power, or wish to reduce reliance on fossil fuels. The Dixons have served customers across Nebraska and the broader Midwest through project design, installation, and ongoing technical support.

Jon’s motivation stemmed from a desire to translate his hands‑on mechanical expertise into the renewable sector, while Holly values the independence of business ownership and helping clients build systems that work. Their involvement in community education — teaching at local colleges, exhibiting at energy fairs, and serving on the Nebraskans for Solar board — reflects a commitment to growing the regional clean‑energy knowledge base.
